name: New Delhi
assessment: A fresh complete public e-Dharti snapshot contains 25,999 features. Grouping by propertyid yields 25,768 keys; all 224 repeated-key groups are disjoint and have matching unique_propert_id, with no measured overlap. This refines the older conflicting-geometry assessment: repeated rows are not by themselves invalid if complete components are assembled. Integration still lacks verified publisher-facing identity semantics and production connectivity.
technicalBlockers: The production backend host could not connect to the L&DO publisher in repeated bounded checks (UND_ERR_CONNECT_TIMEOUT); no payload obtained.

The current viewer searches old_propert_id and unique_propert_id; the internal propertyid grouping is not yet established as the durable publisher-facing property identity. Repeated unique_propert_id groups have not been completely audited.
The current source is a JavaScript-wrapped snapshot rather than a direct bounded JSON geometry service. No adapter change is retained while reachability remains unresolved.
nextStep: Confirm a reachable official source or mirror and the viewer-native unique_propert_id semantics, then audit every component of that identity before adapter integration.
